summary: Steep wooded road-fork edge, about 15% grade, with homes around.

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 14 m, 22 m and 25 m from the stretch; houses all round the fork.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb runs along a vegetated wedge between two streets; no clear pull-off beside the lane.
drivers.traffic: Quiet suburban streets with a few parked cars.
drivers.convention: No signs; cars park on the opposite side.

flags: Mapped locked gate 156 m away, not on the only access
sun_shade: Dense tree canopy over the south side; shaded.
